system.description:
You trigger a full-system fault in a target's flesh and any augments it carries, dealing massive necrotic damage as everything shuts down at once. A construct reduced to 0 HP by this spell cannot be repaired without a full rebuild.

Scaling: At dice count 3, the fault jumps to a second target within 10 feet. At dice count 6, affected creatures are also stunned until the end of their next turn.
